title: An Earthquake Stretched This Bridge Before It Was Even Finished

scenes.text: An earthquake made this bridge one metre longer.
It is the Akashi Kaikyo Bridge in Japan, and it was not even finished.
In 1995, the Kobe earthquake hit while only the two towers stood.
The ground shifted, and the towers ended up about a metre further apart.
Engineers simply lengthened the centre span. It is now 1,991 metres long.
The bridge took no serious damage. The earthquake just changed the blueprint.

description:
In 1995 the Kobe earthquake pushed the two towers of the unfinished Akashi Kaikyo Bridge about a metre further apart.
Engineers lengthened the centre span, and the finished bridge is 1,991 metres long.
Would you drive across it? Comment below.
first_comment: An earthquake literally changed the design on the fly. What other building was altered by a disaster?
